page.notes: Ligatures and abbreviations (æ, œ, ꝑ-type forms, tilde-free) are copied as printed. The chapter reference "Cap. XVIII." belongs to the running head, not to a heading. The marginal note's ♦ mark is a printed symbol and is kept. The left margin note "Senfitivo & Rationali" is placed at the line where it stands. The note "Voluptas oritur vel ex sensu, vel ex appetitu, coq;" ends in an unclear abbreviation. The word "nonim" and the form "ha" are read as printed but are doubtful. A small stray mark "/" stands beside "vel ex ap-" and is not transcribed.
